sonnet.problem: Verse 23 hasn't been told on any story card. The blank asks the baker to guess a single word of Jesus's line (bowl, basket or jar), and nothing earlier lets them reason it out. This is guessing wording, which is luck.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line. / The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: The card tells the disciples' deep grief at hearing that one of them will betray Jesus, which is a serious-sin moment. It then makes a smoke-alarm joke about it.
sonnet.rule: A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke. He can show care instead, marked as his own ("I think this one hurts").
